delegation.context: Reply to the choice whether new CDC versions should be checked and switched automatically like NHI and TFDA (option A); the owner chose A and asked to start the CDC work. The first roster was reviewed under cdc-labs-r1-ai-review/1.

reviewer_note: Automated checks run by the daily schedule under the owner's delegation; no person or AI reads each new roster version.

ODS-R1-SOURCE.purpose: The new raw artifact is the recognized laboratory roster attached to the official CDC page.
checklist: The landing page is https://www.cdc.gov.tw/Category/Page/02d-tR1nzB8QuflX-NmM_w on www.cdc.gov.tw over HTTPS.
Exactly one attachment link is labelled 傳染病認可檢驗機構名冊<7-digit version>.ods and points to a /File/Get/ path on www.cdc.gov.tw.
The download file name equals the attachment label and the roster sheet name carries the same version.
fetch.json is canonical and its artifact size and SHA-256 match the stored raw ODS.

ODS-R1-STRUCTURE.purpose: The new version keeps the reviewed structure and changed by an ordinary amount.
checklist: The ODS passes the archive limits and the header equals the 12 researched columns in order.
Row count and distinct certificate count each changed by at most 10 percent from the serving version.
The blank rate of each column except 最近一次年度能力試驗審查 rose by at most 2 percentage points.
At least 10 golden cases chosen and parsed by an independent DOM parser pass against the new raw ODS.
Before the pointer switches, the independent parser compares every curated row with the raw ODS: sheet name, expanded row number, row hash and all 12 raw values.

ODS-R1-CONTENT.purpose: The served values keep the meaning reviewed under cdc-labs-r1-ai-review/1.
checklist: The roster reading rules (parser, schema and normalization identity) equal those of the serving build; a version read by changed rules is held back.
Query results keep the attribution, the roster version, does_not_confirm_current_acceptance=true and the note 非疾管署官方服務，內容以疾管署公告為準。

PUB-R1-OWNER.purpose: A version that passes every automated check may replace the served version on the local MCP runtime.
checklist: Only an installed distribution may publish.
A version that fails any check is not published; the served version keeps serving and is marked as having a newer candidate.
The owner is emailed after each automatic publish and after each held-back version.
Review records and golden cases name the reviewer as automated-check:cdc-labs-auto-update, never as a person or as the owner.
GitHub Release download bundles are not covered by this protocol version.

golden_cases.selection: Rows matching the coverage list of cdc-labs-r1-ai-review/1 first when such rows exist, then evenly spaced rows until 12 cases exist.
golden_cases.comparison: Compare each expected value, sheet name, expanded row number and row hash with an independent parse of the raw ODS.
